Today and tomorrow

Current brand vs future brand

The goal is not to replace Wanda's essence. It is to give that essence a structure: clearer offers, better customer journeys, reliable follow-up and a brand experience that feels as intentional as the work itself.

Current state

Strong purpose, fragmented system

Ketiwe has a compelling story and product potential, but much of the value still depends on Wanda explaining it personally.

–
Meaningful brand idea
Powerful spiritual and transformation positioning.
–
Individual offers
Services and products exist, but are not yet presented as one journey.
–
Manual enquiries
Leads, bookings and follow-up can easily live in messages or memory.
–
Inconsistent visibility
Content can inspire, but does not always lead people to a clear next step.

Future ecosystem

Four pillars. One Ketiwe.

The future brand becomes easier to understand when every offer has a natural home. These four pillars allow Ketiwe to grow without losing its spiritual centre.

01

Healing

Chakra balancing, spiritual guidance, meditation, emotional healing, mindset work and personal transformation sessions.

02

Elevation

Confidence, abundance, purpose, leadership, business growth and personal empowerment programmes.

03

Rituals

Impepho tea, body scrubs, beauty products, scents and wellness items designed for intentional daily practice.

04

Community

Workshops, group programmes, events and educational content that build belonging and shared transformation.

Scope, limits and terms

Included scope

  • Coverage is limited to the quantities listed in this SKU or signed service order.
  • Only the listed recurring service and delivery activities are included.
  • Infrastructure is limited to the listed compute, storage, transfer, backup, or management envelope.
  • Support is limited to the listed channels, incidents, and time allowance.
  • Only changes expressly listed in the selected SKU are included.

Service levels

  • Response targets follow the accepted SLA or signed service order.

Hard limits

  • Minimum term: Monthly
  • 7-day trial where eligible
  • Managed layer includes monitoring, patching, backups, DNS/SSL support, and support only as listed
  • No unlimited support, usage, users, revisions, infrastructure, or custom work is included unless expressly stated.

Out of scope

  • Work outside the selected SKU features or hard limits
  • Customer-side content, data, licensing, or third-party provider delays
  • Custom project work, migrations, onsite work, and integrations unless explicitly included
  • CloudMonkey may pause the affected work or usage until the client approves an upgrade, Build activation, change request, hourly overage, or separate quotation.
  • Requests outside the included scope, hard limits, or selected plan envelope require written approval for a custom quote, change order, or hourly out-of-scope billing before work starts.

Package terms

  • Unused development time, support time, incidents, revisions, infrastructure capacity, and usage allowances do not roll over unless expressly stated.
  • A package limit is a maximum allowance, not a guaranteed amount of work where delivery is blocked by missing content, approvals, access, dependencies, or client delays.
  • Prices are shown in ZAR excluding VAT unless a quote, invoice, or checkout explicitly states otherwise.
Taking a staged approach means Ketiwe can launch, prove the model and scale month to month, rather than committing to a single large build up front. Content creation, planning and scheduling are available as part of this staged path — see the full catalogue at cloudmonkey.co.za/pricing.
